subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB456. 'Identifier-4 shall be an object reference; the predefined object reference SUPER shall not be specified.' The SUPER half and the non-object-reference-identifier half always fired where the re-route reached; the new arm is the sender that is not a reference at all - OoBindSetObjectRef's senderRef-null branch reported BoundUnsupported (unreachable, because the caller declined for exactly that shape) and now reports SR9 naming the operand as written.
